description: The University of Southern California's Center for Advancing Family Caregiver Financial and Workplace Security has launched a new podcast series, The Care Economy: Practical Approaches to Family Caregiving and Financial Well-Being, exploring one of today's most pressing and often overlooked economic issues: unpaid family caregiving. More than one in five U.S. adults provides care for a family member, creating financial strain, workplace disruption, and long-term economic consequences for families and employers alike. Funded by an Administration for Community Living grant, the podcast features solutions-oriented conversations with leaders in policy, finance, workplace benefits, law, and aging services, examining how systems can better protect caregivers' financial stability while strengthening workforce participation and community resilience. Produced and hosted by Maureen Feldman — a former family caregiver and longtime leader in aging and social connection initiatives — the series bridges expert analysis with lived experience to deliver practical, actionable insights for family caregivers and the professionals who support them, including Area Agencies on Aging, healthcare providers, employers, and policymakers. The Care Economy is available on major podcast platforms.

While a part of mindfulness practice is about learning how to relate to difficulty in a new way, it is also important to know when to make modifications within each practice to honor your limits. As we begin, remember the instructions for each meditation or an invitation rather than a command. If any portion of the practice becomes too intense, you can always come back to the breath or feel your feet on the ground to refocus your attention. No matter how you adapt your practice, you’re learning something valuable about yourself and how to manage your thoughts and emotions. This mindfulness meditation podcast is not a replacement for seeking treatment for depression, anxiety, or posttraumatic stress disorder, or other related disorders. If any symptoms of depression begin to cause serious distress, or affect your ability to cope with home life, work, life, or other people, you should seek treatment from a mental health professional. You can find local resources through findtreatment.samhsa.gov.

author: Will Hernandez
description: Welcome to the Heel Federation, a weekly podcast for pro wrestling fans that still love this art form, want it to be good, and aren't afraid to say when it isn't. We're talking about it all, whether it's AEW, WWE, TNA, NJPW, and even the local indie promotion.

title: Tony and Steves World of Sport
author: Tony and Steve Rice
description: Father and Son duo, Tony and Steve Rice, two sports fanatics invite all you sports fans to enjoy everything from the World of sport. Informative chat with big name sports stars, sports debates and a focus on global sporting news. This is also a Podcast for grass roots sport, lesser publicised sports and up and coming talent to have their platform. Truly if you love sport, you will this Podcast.

title: In the Kitchen with Monica
author: Monica Corrado
description:
In the Kitchen with Monica, a new weekly nutrition education livestream and live Q&A from Dr. Cowan's Garden.

Hosted by our friend and colleague Monica Corrado, CNC, CGP, this series explores the powerful connection between traditional foods, time-honored cooking techniques, and vibrant health.

Monica is a teaching chef, consultant, author, speaker, and trusted educator with more than 20 years of experience. Each week, she will combine her knowledge, passion, and signature sense of humor to help you understand not only what to eat, but why it matters.

Through practical nutrition education, nutrient-dense recipes, and traditional food-preparation techniques, Monica will help you build the knowledge and confidence to prepare delicious meals that nourish you and the people you love.

Whether you are beginning your journey with traditional foods or looking to deepen your understanding of real nourishment, each episode will leave you inspired and equipped with practical tools you can use in your own kitchen. 


Dr. Cowan's Garden website: https://www.drcowansgarden.com/
Dr. Cowan's Garden YouTube for Monica's livestreams: https://www.youtube.com/@DrCowansGarden

title: Architects & Builders: The Business History of the Global African Diaspora
author: BEJ Audio Network
description: Architects & Builders explores the entrepreneurs, merchants, industrialists, executives, investors, and institutions that shaped business across Africa and the global African diaspora. Through documentary storytelling and historical research, the series examines the people, enterprises, and economic ideas that continue to influence today's founders, investors, and business leaders.

title: Scripture Origins
author: Scripture Origins
description: Welcome to Scripture Origins, a podcast dedicated to exploring the hidden roots of sacred history and the deeper mysteries of the Bible. We go beyond traditional interpretations to examine ancient texts, forgotten traditions, and controversial questions about humanity’s spiritual origins. From the Nephilim and Giants to the visions of the Book of Enoch, biblical archaeology, and myths connecting ancient civilizations, each documentary combines research and reflection to uncover what may have been lost or misunderstood. If you seek deeper truth beyond the surface, you are in the right place.

title: The Q by QnotesCarolinas
author: QnotesCarolinas
description: The Q by QnotesCarolinas is your front-row seat to LGBTQ+ life across the Carolinas. Hosted by Liz Schob, Vanna Vanity and Chann Daily, each monthly episode goes beyond the headlines with conversations featuring community leaders, artists and changemakers, plus the latest LGBTQ+ news, culture, events and inspiring stories. Produced by Qnotes, the Carolinas' trusted LGBTQ+ news source for more than 40 years, this is where our community comes together to stay informed, connected and inspired.

title: Unpacked with Casey Armstrong
author: ShipBob
description:
Unpacked is where the truth behind starting and growing a brand comes out. 
 
Casey Armstrong, Chief Business Officer at ShipBob, sits down with the founders and CEOs who have built the new age of household name brands and asks the questions you wish you could. 

What broke. What did they get wrong. What would they do differently. And what drives them to do what they do.

Every founder and business has a story. Most of them never get told.

New episodes drop weekly. Subscribe wherever you listen.

title: Happily Ever Maybe with Justin J. Lee
author: Justin J. Lee
description: Real divorce stories from real people. Divorce and separation can be incredibly isolating, but you are not alone. Happily Ever Maybe is a space for people to share stories and advice about their own personal separation and divorce.

title: Two Blondes and Their Bullies
author: Hurley’s Heart Bulldog Rescue
description:
Welcome to Two Blondes and Their Bullies, a podcast for dog lovers who want real, honest conversations about life with their pups. Presented by Hurley’s Heart Bulldog Rescue, this show is all about education, advocacy, and a whole lot of love—especially for bulldogs.
Join your hosts, Ashley & Summer as they share their journey of starting a rescue, the realities of dog ownership, and the lessons they’ve learned along the way. From everyday care tips to bigger topics like dog insurance and navigating serious health conditions such as IVDD (Intervertebral Disc Disease), nothing is off limits.

title: The Business of Language: An ALC Podcast
author: The Association of Language Companies
description: The Business of Language: An ALC Podcast explores the opportunities, challenges, and ideas shaping the language services industry. Through candid conversations with language company owners, executives, industry partners, and subject-matter experts, each episode offers practical insights into leadership, growth, technology, advocacy, workforce trends, and the evolving needs of clients. Produced by the Association of Language Companies, the podcast connects the people and perspectives driving the business of language forward.

title: The People Behind the Pipes
author: Peoples Natural Gas
description: Natural gas knowledge and information from one of America's top regulated utilities, Peoples Natural Gas. Pennsylvania's largest gas utility serving more than 700,000 customers in 18 counties, Peoples has delivered safe, reliable and affordable gas since 1885. Learn from company leaders about the latest safety, affordability, and innovation developments at Peoples and throughout the gas utility industry.

title: Mr. Sleepy True Crime
author: Mr. Sleepy True Crime
description: Welcome to Mr. Sleepy True Crime — where chilling real cases, mysterious disappearances, unsolved crimes, and dark investigations are told in a calm, cinematic narration style. This channel is made for true crime lovers who enjoy deep storytelling, suspenseful case breakdowns, disturbing mysteries, and late-night crime stories that keep you hooked from beginning to end. Every video takes you into the shadows of real incidents, forgotten case files, suspicious details, and the unanswered questions that still haunt people today.

title: Peckish For Answers
author: Peckish For Answers
description: Peckish for Answers is a mystery and conspiracy channel where we dig into unexplained events, hidden truths, and the questions that refuse to stay buried

title: Talk To The Whip
author: Michael Pontz
description:
Welcome to Talk to the Whip, the ultimate forum for carriage drivers and enthusiasts to connect, learn, and share their passion for the sport we love—carriage driving! 
Whether you’re a seasoned Whip or just starting out, this podcast dives into everything from training tips and competition prep to the history, gear, and unique challenges of driving. 
Each episode features amazing guests, lively discussions, and insights that keep you inspired and informed. 
Harness your curiosity and join the conversation—because in carriage driving, there’s always something new to explore!

title: Nita’s World Podcast
author: Nita Mandal
description: Beauty positivity and love

title: Phobicast: Every Fear Has a Story
author: tony rivera
description:
Welcome to Phobicast—where every fear has a story.

Behind every phobia lies a nightmare waiting to be told.

Each episode of Phobicast is an original horror story inspired by a different fear—from the darkness that hides unseen horrors to the endless depths of the ocean, abandoned places, mirrors, dolls, insects, and fears you may have never even heard of.

But these aren't just stories about monsters.

They're stories about people.

Ordinary individuals forced to face their greatest fear in extraordinary circumstances, discovering that courage isn't the absence of fear—it's the decision to keep moving despite it.

If you love psychological horror, suspense, creepy storytelling, and unforgettable characters, then you're in the right place.

So dim the lights, put on your headphones, and ask yourself one question...

What are you afraid of?

title: The Flywheel by M13
author: M13
description: The Flywheel is a podcast for founders, operators and investors building through structural change. M13 partners sit down with the founders reshaping AI, enterprise software, healthcare, commerce, and consumer technology to unpack the hard calls and inflection points as they build category-defining companies. Each conversation is designed to help listeners better understand where the world is changing, what great founders see before others do, and how enduring companies are built.

title: Circassian Encyclopedia Podcast
author: MK Mamser
description: For over a thousand years, they held the northern Caucasus. Then, in one of the 19th century's most devastating and least-remembered tragedies, they were forced from it almost entirely scattered into a diaspora that today spans more than fifty countries across five continents.  This is the Circassian Encyclopedia Podcast, where we sit down with the sources, the field research, and the oral histories to unpack the full story of the Adyghe people

author: Matt Smyth
description: After I Lost You is a podcast about life after loss. After losing my wife Carli, I share my journey through grief, faith, and learning how to keep moving forward. This is a space for real, honest conversations to help you feel less alone and remind you that your circumstances don’t define who you are or who you can become.

Topics including, but not limited to: training, philosophy and psychology. Expect advice, ideas and personal struggles and triumphs.

title: How we deal with it?
author: The Familist Guy
description:
Just a bunch of normal people navigating life’s twists, turns, and total WTF moments. 
We share relatable stories, unpack everyday chaos, and laugh our way through the ups and downs with humour, honesty, and zero filters.
No scripts, no pretending, just unapologetic conversations about the rollercoaster we’re all stuck on.
Sometimes in English, sometimes in Romanian (info in description) and always real.
Strap in. It’s messy, it’s funny, and you’ll definitely realise you’re not the only one trying to figure out this crazy world.
Heads up: Not suitable for young ears. Colourful language ahead.

title: DJ DINO BRAVO IN THE MIX

description:
Welcome to my podcast.

If you’re expecting the usual talk, talk, talk like every other podcast…
you’re definitely in the wrong place.

Because here, it’s all about the music.

Inside, you’ll find my radio mixes, club sets, and even some exclusive corporate DJ sessions all carefully selected to keep the vibe alive.

So turn it up, press play, and enjoy the journey.

title: The Pressure Room
author: Allisa Verhille
description: The Pressure Room is a podcast for leaders, executives, entrepreneurs, and high achievers navigating the hidden cost of success. Join Allisa Verhille for conversations about identity exhaustion, burnout, resilience, reinvention, leadership, and purpose. Through powerful stories and practical insights, you'll discover how to move beyond survival, reclaim your authentic self, and lead with greater clarity, courage, and alignment. The Pressure Room is a production of The Flamekeeper Institute. You are the fire. And it is time to remember who you are.

title: The World Of Crime
author: The World Of Crime
description: The World of Crime® is an exciting new podcast for true crime enthusiasts. Enjoy hours of gripping stories from around the world about serial killers, murderers, kidnappers, con artists, bank robberies, including famous cases like OJ Simpson, Jack the Ripper, Jeffrey Dahmer, Charles Manson and many more. The channel also features a wide selection of true crime films.

author: Horatio Alger Association of Distinguished Americans
description: At a time when the power and promise of the American Dream is more important than ever, the Horatio Alger Association is pleased to re-launch this special biographical show that examines the journeys of our Members. These are truly remarkable individuals who have led extraordinary lives on their paths to success

title: Teams That Win
author: Leadership Development Institute
description:
Leading a team is about the people, and how they work together.
That is at the heart of Teams That Win, a podcast from LSU's Leadership Development Institute, hosted by Lacy Dicharry, where leadership meets team science: the research on what makes teams work.
Every three weeks, Lacy and her guests cover what shapes a team: psychological safety, trust, feedback, coaching, leading through change, and mental health in demanding work. The takeaways are research-backed and practical for anyone who works with other people. Lacy brings twenty years of research and practice to every conversation.

title: Becoming Mira
author: Tamira
description: Every week, I share the real journey of becoming the woman I’m meant to be through career, fitness, faith, finances, and personal growth. If you’re building a better life one step at a time, this podcast is for you.

The SOAP Project Show with Theresa Flores is a powerful, awareness‑driven podcast where communities come together to protect children and stand against human trafficking.

Human trafficking thrives in silence, but hope begins with awareness—and every conversation shared, every volunteer who steps forward, and every act of support helps fuel real change. Together, we can make a difference.

 What are you pumped about? Share with us at pumpupyourvolumepod@gmail.com, and let's celebrate together.

title: Out Loud with Kennedy
author: Kennedy
description:
I’m Kennedy, and every week I’m speaking out loud about the things we usually keep to ourselves—dating, heartbreak, healing, friendships, mental health, identity, confidence, and everything that comes with growing into yourself. I also share honest conversations about living with HSV, breaking down stigma, answering the questions no one wants to ask, and making sexual health feel a little less scary and a lot more human.

Whether you’re here because you have HSV, you’re supporting someone who does, or you’re simply trying to figure out life one messy chapter at a time, you’re welcome here.

No shame. No perfection. Just real conversations, real growth, and saying the quiet parts out loud.

title: Rage Bait
author: Shane DiMaio
description:
Rage Bait is a fast-paced interview podcast from The Staten Island Advance and SILive.com that shines a spotlight on the creators, entrepreneurs, entertainers, and personalities with Staten Island roots who have built successful brands on social media and beyond.

Hosted by Reporter Shane DiMaio with equal parts curiosity, humor, and playful sarcasm, each episode dives into the stories behind the success while mixing in lighthearted roasting, bold questions, and unexpected conversations that keep guests — and listeners — on their toes.

From viral influencers and business owners to comedians, athletes, and local legends, Rage Bait explores what it really takes to stand out in today's digital world. You'll hear the wins, the failures, the behind-the-scenes moments, and plenty of laughs along the way.

Whether you're looking for inspiration, entertainment, or just want to see your favorite Staten Islanders get gently "rage baited," this podcast delivers honest conversations with personalities who know how to make an impact online and in real life.

title: The American Enterprise Party by Jerry Rhoads
author: Momentum Media Advertising
description: This season of The American Enterprise Party by Jerry Rhoads takes you on a provocative journey from the depths of political gridlock and America's hidden debt crisis to a revolutionary blueprint for national renewal. You will shed your frustration with the broken two-party duopoly and emerge with a clear, hopeful understanding of how a third-party swing vote can restore the American Dream. Through nine gripping episodes, you will transition from a passive observer of political division into an empowered advocate armed with the ultimate strategy to save our great enterprise.  You will master the financial realities of our national debt by learning how GAAP principles expose the government's hidden liabilities. You will walk away with a robust five-part framework to analyze governance failures and bypass partisan media spin. Finally, you will gain concrete knowledge of a revolutionary macroeconomic toolkit—including a flat five percent net worth assessment and strategic privatization—to help America out-compete global rivals like China.  This podcast is custom-built for independent thinkers, fatigued voters, and patriotic citizens who are exhausted by the endless bickering of the political duopoly and crave real, logical solutions. If you believe in the power of free enterprise and humanism but feel politically homeless in today's polarized landscape, this season was made for you. It is your invitation to stop mourning the decline of the American Dream and start building its future.

title: True Crime Julia
author: True Crime Julia
description: Welcome to True Crime Julia! From GBV cases and femicides, to insurance murders, shocking disappearances, and high-profile court cases, we bring you timely, factual, and gripping storytelling straight from the headlines. Our mission is to inform, expose, and raise awareness about crime in South Africa. Every story is thoroughly researched, with court updates, investigation details, and exclusive insights, giving victims a voice and keeping you updated on the latest true crime developments.

title: Still Becoming
author: Still Becoming with Rukiya
description:
Still Becoming is a podcast about changing course in work and life. As I document my own transition into nursing, I talk with people who have changed careers, gone back to school, started businesses, reinvented themselves more than once, or are still standing in the middle of the change.
These are honest conversations about what transformation really requires—the fear, money, timing, relationships, setbacks, small wins, and what it feels like to become a beginner again when you are already responsible for an entire life.
Some guests have reached the other side. Others are still figuring it out. Along the way, I’ll share my own decisions, doubts, progress, and the moments when the plan needs another plan.
You do not need to have your whole life figured out to begin. You may just need to admit that something in you is ready to move.
So, what are you becoming now?

title: She Is Me
author: Jamila Carr-Bankston
description:
She Is Me with Jamilah Renae is a weekly podcast about womanhood, healing, faith, family and identity. Its where honest conversations, powerful storytelling, and spoken word poetry come together to explore and talk about personal growth.

Each episode is an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman in the mirror. Through heartfelt stories, life lessons, and original poetry, Jamilah creates a space where listeners are reminded that their scars don't define them—they shape them. Whether you're rebuilding, rediscovering yourself, chasing a dream, or simply looking for encouragement, this podcast is a place where authenticity is celebrated and healing has a voice. Because every woman has a story.

title: Monsters on Break – Behind the Mask

Each episode features conversations with scare actors, attraction owners, designers, makeup artists, producers and the teams who bring unforgettable live experiences to life. Expect honest stories, industry insights and a look at what really happens behind the scenes at haunted attractions and immersive events.

Conceiving Miracles is a podcast created to bring hope, education, and meaningful support to individuals and families navigating fertility challenges. Through honest conversations, personal stories, and practical insight, each episode explores the emotional, physical, and deeply personal journey of trying to conceive.

Dr Rebecca Chabot (PhD scientist and TEDx speaker) and David Masterton (AI consultant and recovering corporate high-achiever) translate real research on stress, busyness, habits and performance into tools you can actually use. Expect honest stories, the occasional dad joke, and zero guru-speak. title: Becoming FutureHuman
author: BriarPrestidge
description:
We're living through the fastest, strangest, most exhilarating shift in human history, and it's easy to feel like you're falling behind in a game you never agreed to play. Becoming FutureHuman exists to hand you the controller. Each week, futurist Briar Prestidge sits down with the scientists, founders, and visionaries building the future, not just to marvel at the technology, but to ask the more important question: what does this make possible for how we live, love, work, and heal? 
Because the future isn't something that happens to you. It's who you choose to become.

No guilt, no gimmicks, and no perfection required. Just real-life tools to help you become stronger, healthier, and a little more confident.

title: Talking Newark

Talking Newark is the podcast for everything happening in and around Newark.
Featuring local guests, business owners, community leaders and event organisers, we chat about the people, stories and events shaping the town. 
From local businesses and upcoming events to honest conversations and hidden gems, Talking Newark celebrates the community and the voices behind it. 
If it’s happening in Newark, we’re talking about it.

title: The Hilarious World of Depression
author: American Public Media
description: A show about clinical depression...with laughs? Well, yeah. Depression is an incredibly common and isolating disease experienced by millions, yet often stigmatized by society. The Hilarious World of Depression is a series of frank, moving, and, yes, funny conversations with top comedians who have dealt with this disease, hosted by veteran humorist and public radio host John Moe. Join guests such as Maria Bamford, Paul F. Tompkins, Andy Richter, and Jen Kirkman to learn how they’ve dealt with depression and managed to laugh along the way. If you have not met the disease personally, it’s almost certain that someone you know has, whether it’s a friend, family member, colleague, or neighbor. Depression is a vicious cycle of solitude and stigma that leaves people miserable and sometimes dead. Frankly, we’re not going to put up with that anymore. The Hilarious World of Depression is not medical treatment and should not be seen as a substitute for therapy or medication. But it is a chance to gain some insight, have a few laughs, and realize that people with depression are not alone and that together, we can all feel a bit better. American Public Media and HealthPartners’ Make It Okay campaign are committed to breaking the stigma around mental health.

title: Virtual SMS Numbers as a Tool for Online Verification
author: Topi Cade
description:
In the digital age, the need for quick and secure online account registration has grown tremendously. Platforms like SMS-ACTIVATE allow users to receive sms online, offering virtual numbers that can be used for verification on a wide range of websites and apps. These numbers provide a convenient alternative to personal phone numbers, enabling individuals to protect their privacy while still completing registration processes efficiently.
Global access without physical constraints
Virtual SMS numbers remove the limitations traditionally linked to geography. Users can select numbers from multiple countries and use them from anywhere in the world. This flexibility is particularly valuable for people who need to register accounts on international platforms without physically being in those countries.
Privacy protection in online registration
One of the main advantages of using virtual numbers is enhanced personal data security. By using a virtual number instead of a personal one, users reduce the risk of unwanted messages and maintain a clear separation between their private contacts and online accounts. This approach has become essential for those managing multiple social media profiles, business accounts, or temporary registrations.
Fully online management
Unlike traditional SIM-based solutions, virtual SMS numbers operate entirely online. All functions — from receiving messages to configuring preferences — are accessible via web platforms or mobile applications. This centralized model ensures that users can manage their numbers quickly and securely without any physical hardware.
Business-friendly features
Companies also benefit from virtual SMS numbers. They can streamline verification processes, scale account creation workflows, and use local numbers in multiple countries without establishing offices abroad. Features like SMS filtering and message forwarding help businesses maintain efficiency and manage high volumes of account registrations.
Cost efficiency and scalability
Virtual numbers generally offer lower costs compared with traditional phone lines. Flexible pricing models allow short-term or long-term use, making them ideal for both individual users and organizations that require numbers for temporary campaigns or large-scale registrations.
How to get started
Acquiring a virtual number through SMS-ACTIVATE is straightforward. Users create an account, select a number from a preferred country, and configure usage settings. In some cases, additional verification may be required depending on local regulations or the type of number.
Conclusion
Virtual SMS numbers are becoming an essential tool for online account registration. Platforms like SMS-ACTIVATE make it possible to receive sms online easily and securely, providing global accessibility, privacy protection, and operational simplicity. For anyone managing multiple online accounts or seeking a safe way to verify identities, virtual numbers are increasingly the go-to solution.

title: Virtual Phone Numbers: How They Work and Why They Matter
author: Deep Tongue
description:
Virtual phone numbers are becoming a new standard in digital communication. These numbers operate over the internet, allowing users to receive calls and SMS messages without a physical SIM card. Services like receive SMS make using these numbers even more convenient, providing stable access and enhanced privacy. In recent years, virtual numbers have grown in popularity, especially among users who value flexibility, cost efficiency, and personal data protection.
Virtual numbers rely on VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), a technology that transmits voice over the internet. When someone calls a virtual number, the call is first routed through a cloud telephony server before being forwarded to the user’s device — whether a smartphone, laptop, tablet, or PC. If the device is unavailable, the call can be redirected to voicemail or another number. Tools such as receive SMS further improve reliability, particularly when receiving verification codes or messages from multiple sources.
To use a virtual number, a device with internet access and specialized software is required. This makes virtual numbers highly versatile: calls and messages can be sent and received from anywhere in the world with an internet connection.
Benefits of Virtual Numbers
  1. Privacy. Virtual numbers allow users to stay anonymous when signing up for websites and apps that require phone number verification.
  2. Versatility. Unlike traditional SIM cards, virtual numbers can be used across multiple devices without the need to swap cards.
  3. Internet-Based Access. Calls and SMS don’t require a mobile network — only an internet connection.
  4. Cost Efficiency. Virtual numbers are generally cheaper than traditional mobile numbers and do not incur international roaming fees, making them ideal for frequent travelers or remote workers.
  5. Flexibility. Virtual numbers can be configured with call forwarding, auto-attendants, and other features, which is useful for both personal and business purposes. Services like receive SMS can simplify handling verification messages or one-time codes securely.

Use Cases
  • Receiving one-time SMS messages and bulk notifications.

  • Anonymous registration on online services and social media platforms.

Virtual numbers offer a modern communication solution that combines convenience, cost-effectiveness, and security. As remote work and global mobility continue to rise, virtual numbers are becoming an increasingly essential tool for both individuals and businesses.

Each conversation examines story not simply as memory or entertainment, but as a force that shapes identity, belonging, relationships, leadership, culture, and human agency.

At the center of the project is one question:

How malleable are the stories we live by, and what does it take to change one?

Across 100 conversations, Paige is listening for the human capacities that help us recognize the stories shaping us, discern whether they remain true or useful, and participate more consciously in what comes next.

The ideas and insights gathered through the project will inform the foundational book Paige is writing to help define the emerging field of Narrative Intelligence.

Mises argues that socialism is destined to fail because it cannot adequately address the complexities of economic calculation. title: Complete Works of Brann, The Iconoclast, Volume 12
author: William Cowper Brann
description: William Cowper Brann, aptly nicknamed The Iconoclast, boldly challenged the status quo, targeting institutions and beliefs he deemed arrogant and self-serving. Settling in the rugged town of Waco, Texas, during the late 1800s, Brann made his mark as a newspaper man—first as a writer and later as the owner of The Iconoclast newspaper. This tumultuous period saw fierce battles between Catholics and Protestants over Texass soul, with further sectarian conflicts among Protestants. Branns prolific writing style and unapologetic opinions made waves, as he fiercely criticized Baptists, Prohibition, and universities with the ferocity of a gunfight—an irony not lost on history, as he met his own demise in a shootout at the age of 43. After being shot in the back, he managed to draw his weapon and kill his assailant, before walking himself to jail, where he ultimately died the next morning. Volume 12 features a collection of his thought-provoking newspaper editorials, reflections on his untimely death, and a mix of both praise and critique of his brash, junk-yard-dog approach to journalism. Prepare for a captivating listening experience filled with his sharp insights and unforgettable rhetoric!

This podcast breaks you out of the monotonous routine and brings you to the heart of bus station life and everything that makes it tick. It explores the people who keep it going up and running and the happenings that unfold within this unique space.

Each episode dives into various topics, including events, transportation news, bus travel safety, experiences, and much more.
You will learn about this unique environment through the eyes of its visitors, drivers, and workers. Every aspect of bus stantion is discussed, from the short trips to the most extreme travels and the communities found at these stations. The podcast is perfect for travelers, commuters, and curious minds interested in learning about this transport wonderland. So hop on board and begin uncovering all the amazing tales and stories that await at every corner!

title: The DC Beer Show
author: DC Beer
description: The official podcast of DCBeer ! Everything you need to know about the people, places, and brews that make the DMV America’s best beer scene, including the best local places for eats, brews, trivia, live music, and more! Learn about the latest trends in craft beer – from the beers, to the breweries, to the business – from the gang at DC Beer.

title: Grace To Go with the Route 66 Chaplain
author: Christopher Tuttle
description:
Grace To Go is a weekly Sunday series from Christopher Tuttle, the Route 66 Chaplain. Every episode starts with something real, a moment on the road, at a rest stop, behind the wheel somewhere between exits, and lets a short scripture reframe it into something you can actually carry into your week.
This isn't a sermon and it isn't church. You don't need a pew or a church background to feel what's here, just a few minutes and a cup of coffee. Grace To Go is part of the Faith and Good Courage family, alongside Roadside Notes and Healing Highway, all rooted in Route 66 and the sacred moments hiding in ordinary life.
New episodes every Sunday morning. Coffee's always on.

title: Christian Poetry, Prayers, Reminders, Reflections, and Life Lessons
author: Erica Felisa Thompson
description: Erica Felisa Thompson is sharing Christian Poetry, Prayers, Reminders, Reflections, and Life Lessons in light of real life situations on your walk with God. Most of the episodes are from her series Spirit Man which can be found on Amazon. Thanks in advance for your support and I pray that God pours back into you a hundred fold!!! Love y’all with the love of God!!!!

title: The Green Grimoire Podcast
author: Damh and Cerri
description: A monthly podcast that explores the Book of Nature - The Green Grimiore - from a Pagan/Animist point of view. Join Damh the Cerri as they discuss topics drawn from the magical ’Jar of Inspiration’.

title: Audio. GA4-240202501-AA1-EV02
author: JOSE JANNER BONILLA RAMIREZ
description: Evidence Audio. GA4-240202501-AA1-EV02

title: Aging Gracefully with Julie
author: WIHS Network
description: Aging Gracefully with Julie is a podcast that was created by a registered nurse and certified senior advisor, Julie Cruz. The podcast was created for adults, typically in their 40s to 50s, who are simultaneously managing the care, financial support, and daily needs of their children and aging parents. It is also for seniors 65+. The podcast delivers information in a holistic manner by diving into the mental, emotional, physical and spiritual being of the listener. All while providing education, guidance and resources for families caring for elderly loved ones as well as for seniors.

title: Prose Society with Eli Rallo
author: iHeartPodcasts
description: If your bookshelf and your For You Page are equally important to your personality… welcome home. This is Prose Society — a weekly podcast by Eli Rallo that’s part book club, part group chat for thought daughters, pop culture scholars, and anyone who thinks Pride and Prejudice and Love Island deserve the same level of discourse. See you between the pages!

title: Dad, Interrupted
author: Dad, Interrupted
description:
This podcast is here to help dads navigate the messy intersection of fatherhood, mental health, personal identity, and relationships - one interruption at a time.
Visit our Linktree: linktr.ee/dadinterruptedpod

title: Beyond the Desert- A Tale of Death Valley
author: Alfred Noyes
description: Immerse yourself in a gripping short novel that weaves together adventure, philosophy, and the complexities of world politics. Follow the journey of an accused criminal who escapes into the vast, unforgiving expanse of Death Valley, California. There, he faces the harsh realities of nature and encounters a fascinating array of eccentric desert dwellers. With poetic prose that vividly paints the landscape and a passionate undercurrent of political activism, this work showcases the talents of an English author renowned as a poet, best known for The Highwayman. While primarily a poet, he also crafted thought-provoking prose infused with an anti-war sentiment. (This preview may be edited later.) - Summary by Douglas Wood

title: Amelia (Vol. 1)
author: Henry Fielding
description: In the captivating first volume of a three-part series, Amelia defies her mothers wishes by marrying William Booth, leading them to a new life in London. As they navigate the complexities of married life, Fielding deftly examines themes of infidelity and the contentious debate over womens intelligence compared to mens. Join Amelia on her journey of love, struggle, and self-discovery. (Summary by Libby Gohn)

title: Sonday Sessions
author: Nate and Josiah Galvante
description: Sonday Sessions is a podcast where two brothers in ministry have honest conversations about following Jesus and pursuing a life of holiness in a world full of distractions, shifting culture, and competing ideas.

title: Noticiero Buenos Días Quincy WA
author: The Fallible Man LLC
description:
Descargo de responsabilidad: Este programa ha sido traducido del inglés al español mediante inteligencia artificial con el propósito de servir y llegar a más personas de nuestra comunidad. Aunque hacemos todo lo posible por ofrecer una traducción clara y precisa, es posible que existan pequeños errores o diferencias de interpretación. Agradecemos sus comentarios y sugerencias para seguir mejorando y ofrecer un mejor servicio a toda la comunidad del 98848.


Buenos Días Quincy WA


Tu fuente diaria de noticias locales.


Buenos Días Quincy WA es un pódcast matutino de lunes a viernes dedicado a mantener informado, conectado y con una sonrisa al corazón de la Cuenca del Columbia. Cubriendo Quincy, Winchester, George y Crescent Bar, este programa se enfoca en las personas, los lugares y las historias que hacen que nuestra comunidad se sienta como un verdadero hogar.


Cada episodio es una actualización matutina breve y fácil de escuchar (15 a 30 minutos, de lunes a viernes), diseñada para acompañarte mientras disfrutas tu café o te diriges al trabajo. Hablaremos de:

  • El pronóstico del tiempo local
  • Próximos eventos y lo más reciente de la comunidad
  • Noticias escolares, deportes, música, teatro y actividades
  • Actualizaciones de la policía, los bomberos y los servicios de emergencia
  • Lo más importante del Concejo Municipal y de la Junta Escolar
  • Eventos gratuitos organizados por negocios locales, iglesias y grupos comunitarios


Los lunes analizamos con más detalle lo que ocurrió en la comunidad durante el fin de semana, mientras que los viernes te ayudamos a planificar lo que viene: partidos, eventos, reuniones y actividades para disfrutar los próximos días.


Buenos Días Quincy WA no trata de los grandes titulares de las ciudades. Se trata de nuestros vecinos, nuestras escuelas y nuestra comunidad. Con un tono amigable, positivo y orgulloso de nuestras raíces, este programa es como esa conversación en el porche al comenzar cada día entre semana.

Ya seas residente de toda la vida o recién hayas llegado al área, toma tu café y comienza el día bien informado.


Si es importante en el 98848, ¡aquí lo escucharás!

Este programa se traduce del inglés al español mediante inteligencia artificial.

title: Story Of A Modern Woman
author: Ella Hepworth Dixon
description: This poignant short novel follows the journey of Mary Earl, a woman navigating the challenges of life in London at the close of the 19th century. As she strives to become a writer, Mary finds herself constrained by the rigid format expected of her work—one that confounds her creativity. Complicating her situation is her romance with a married man, adding to the emotional turmoil she faces. Celebrated as one of the finest examples of new woman literature, this story sheds light on the myriad struggles encountered by single women of the era, all conveyed through vivid prose that will resonate deeply with readers. - Summary by Stav Nisser

title: The Real Eddy Rivera Show
author: Eddy Rivera
description:
The Real Eddy Rivera Show builds strong foundations through real conversations, biblical truth, and authentic life experiences. We discuss faith, family, business, leadership, failure, and purpose, challenging people to grow spiritually, mentally, emotionally, and physically through a relationship with Jesus Christ. We don't just create content—we build people.
Real Talk. Real Faith. Real Life. Real Change.
Distributed by ATR Media LLC and The Real Eddy Rivera

title: The Meeked Horse Podcast
author: J8 Global
description: Welcome to The Meeked Horse Podcast: a space for dreamers, pioneering leaders, and disruptors – those brave enough to do life differently. MHP is hosted by Andy Williames, Doug McKinley, and Jonathan Gulley, business partners who in each episode confront the defining stories we've inherited while challenging us to lead from a place of meekness – power that can be trusted in any situation!

title: Inside The Colony
author: City of The Colony
description:
Inside The Colony is the official City podcast of the City of The Colony. Each episode features conversations with City leaders, department experts, elected officials and community partners discussing the projects, services and initiatives shaping our community. 
From public safety and infrastructure to economic development, special events and future planning, Inside The Colony offers a closer look at the work happening behind the scenes to keep The Colony thriving. 
Informative, engaging and community-focused, the podcast connects listeners with the people and stories driving a City forward.

title: SCREAMING: Horror Lives Here
author: Joshua Robert CEO of HOT AIR Network
description:
Welcome to SCREAMING, the horror podcast where we explore everything that goes bump in the night.

Hosted by Joshua Robert, SCREAMING is your monthly destination for the latest horror movie news, horror TV shows, movie reviews, spoiler discussions, ending explanations, trailers, first-look reactions, franchise updates, Stephen King adaptations, slasher films, supernatural horror, psychological thrillers, paranormal stories, haunted places, urban legends, creepy internet mysteries, true crime, and everything happening in the world of horror.


Every episode dives into the biggest horror headlines, breaks down the newest movies and television series, explores classic and modern horror franchises, and discusses the stories, filmmaking, practical effects, lore, and terrifying moments that horror fans can't stop talking about. From Scream, Friday the 13th, A Nightmare on Elm Street, Evil Dead, Halloween, The Conjuring, Terrifier, Final Destination, Carrie, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, and The Last of Us to independent horror films, hidden gems, haunted history, paranormal phenomena, and real-life mysteries, if it's creepy, cursed, possessed, haunted, or simply strange... we'll probably be talking about it.


Whether you're looking for your next scary movie, want the latest horror news, love deep dives into iconic franchises, enjoy spoiler-filled reviews, or just appreciate a fun conversation with someone who's just as obsessed with horror as you are, you've found your new favorite podcast.


New episodes drop monthly. Turn off the lights. Turn up the volume. Horror Lives Here.

title: Red Fence
author: Red Fence
description:
Welcome to Red Fence is where politics gets pulled apart—no talking points, no filters, no blind loyalty. Each episode dives into the stories shaping America and the world, cutting through media spin, government narratives, and the noise to ask the questions most people won’t.
From controversial headlines to underreported angles, Redfence challenges the official version and explores what’s really going on beneath the surface. Whether it’s policy, power, or hidden agendas, nothing is off-limits.
If you’re tired of being told what to think and want a sharper, more independent perspective, come on in.

title: Once Upon a Demigods Journey
author: Victoria Cervantes
description: Hii call me Vic/Vicky, i like the Percy Jackson series, the Inheritance games, and Once upon a Time. I post edits here, but feel free to give me recommendations on what to post. Here we support everyone and everything! Enjoy!

title: Relentless Restart
author: Gail DeMarco
description:
Nobody posts the part where it fell apart. We share the wins, the after photo, the comeback — almost never the middle, when you're starting from zero and not sure you've got it in you to go again. That middle is the whole show.

Relentless Restart is where people tell the story behind the story. Hosted by Gail DeMarco, every episode goes past the highlight reel to the real thing: the setback, the moment everything changed, and the decision to start over when walking away would have been easier.

These are honest, unfiltered conversations about resilience, redemption, and second chances, with people who have lived them. If you've ever had to begin again, or you're in the middle of it right now, this is for you.

New episodes released regularly. Follow the show so the next story finds you.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Grief, Trauma & Your Mama
author: Angela Schellenberg
description:
Grief is trauma, because it is a break in attachment.

Angela Schellenberg is a grief and trauma therapist specializing in attachment, grief, and equine assisted learning. She lost both of her parents while she was still coming of age, and spent years believing she was broken before she understood what had actually happened to her.

This show is the manual she went looking for and could not find. Conversations about why grief lives in the body, how loss reshapes your identity, your self esteem and your sense of safety, and what it takes to feel safe again.

Attachment wounds are always healable. That is the whole reason this exists.

title: Deep Bible Stories
author: Deep Bible Stories
description:
Deep Bible Stories is where Christians come to go deeper into Scripture — book by book, chapter by chapter, line by line.

Every week we publish new teachings on the books of the Bible, the life of Christ, the prophets, the writings, and the truths most believers were never taught.

If you've been blessed here on YouTube and you'd like the full library — every course we've ever made plus every new lesson we release each week, ad-free, on every device — there's a quiet place for you to keep going:
👉 deepbiblestories.com/founding

title: Sports Love Affair: Incredible Stories
author: Willie Lee
description:
A Sports Love Affair: Incredible Stories takes you beyond the box scores, championships, and highlight reels to uncover the unforgettable journeys that have shaped the world of sports. Each episode explores the remarkable lives of athletes, coaches, teams, and moments that inspired generations through perseverance, sacrifice, courage, redemption, and triumph.

From unlikely underdogs and forgotten heroes to iconic games and history-changing moments, you’ll discover the human side of sports—the stories that remind us why we fell in love with the game in the first place.

title: Between The Verses
author: Daniel Moreau; Hannah Moreau
description: Between The Verses is a Bible exploration podcast hosted by Daniel & Hannah Moreau, where curiosity meets Scripture. Each episode dives into the history, culture, context, and deeper meaning behind God's Word. Together, we explore biblical mysteries, ask thought-provoking questions, and uncover the connections that bring Scripture to life. Whether you're new to the Bible or have studied it for years, join us as we discover what lies between the verses—one conversation at a time.

title: Before I Go Inside
author: Raven V
description: Hi, I’m Raven. This is the part of the day where I sit in my car a little longer than I need to. Sometimes I go down random rabbit holes. Sometimes I vent. Sometimes I overshare. Sometimes I solve absolutely nothing. If you’re looking for polished, this probably isn’t it. If you’re looking for honest, pull up a seat.

title: The African Possibility Podcast
author: Emmanuel Ogbaki
description:
The African Possibility Podcast explores the ideas, stories, and experiences shaping Africans across the diaspora and the continent. Through thoughtful conversations with leaders, thinkers, professionals, and creatives, the podcast highlights the possibilities, challenges, and opportunities facing Africans worldwide.
The African Possibility Podcast is a place where Africans can speak in their own words about their journeys, struggles, ideas, and hopes for the future.

title: Custom of the Country
author: Edith Wharton
description: Edith Whartons 1913 novel presents a sharp critique of American ambition and social climbing, following the relentless Undine Spragg on her quest for wealth and status. From the fictional Apex City in the Midwest to the bustling streets of New York and the glamour of Paris, Undines journey is marked by her determination to secure her place in high society, even if it means navigating the complexities of multiple marriages and divorces. - Summary by Elizabeth Klett

title: The CheckRare Brief
author: Peter Ciszewski, CheckRare
description:
A weekly roundup of the latest news in rare disease.

The CheckRare Brief delivers a concise roundup of the week's most important developments in rare diseases. Each episode covers FDA approvals, clinical trial updates, conference highlights, scientific publications, and industry news that matter to healthcare professionals, researchers, advocates, and the rare disease community.

Produced by CheckRare, The CheckRare Brief helps you stay informed—in just a few minutes each week.

Each episode covers FDA approvals, clinical trial updates, conference highlights, scientific publications, and industry news that matter to healthcare professionals, researchers, advocates, and the rare disease community.   Produced by CheckRare, The CheckRare Brief keeps you informed on the latest news that .

title: The Last Level Podcast
author: The Last Level Podcast
description:
I am a video game nerd from Dublin, Ireland with a love of nostalgia and all things gaming. Join me each week as I discuss my favourite video games. 
Created by Naoise O’Hare

title: Youth Ministry Debrief
author: Josh Griffin
description: Join Josh Griffin for the ride home after youth group in his soccer-mom 2018 Ford Flex! The drive home is 15-25 minutes - depending on how ugly the traffic is here in Southern California. Raw and uncut, thoughts, reaction, strategies, tips, tricks and more on the commute.

title: The Lone Ranger
author: The Lone Ranger
description: The Lone Ranger: In Pursuit of Justice Beneath the desert moon, the Lone Ranger and his faithful companion Tonto ride through the dunes on another epic journey. Out of the shadows and into the silence of the frontier, follow the story of the legendary masked hero who became the West's ultimate symbol of justice. Hit play and join the night ride

title: Education, Explained with John-Lloyd Williams
author: John-Lloyd Williams | JLW Education Consultancy
description:
Clear, practical conversations about the challenges shaping education today.
Created and curated by Headteacher and education consultant John-Lloyd Williams, the programme explores leadership, school improvement, curriculum, assessment, SEND, family advocacy and the modernisation of education.
Episodes use AI-generated presenters created through Google NotebookLM. Topics and source materials are selected and reviewed by John-Lloyd, with each discussion designed to turn complex educational issues into informed ideas and practical next steps.

title: The Long Way There
author: Sara and Brady Hand
description:
Welcome to The Long Way There, an infertility and IVF podcast for couples navigating the long road to parenthood.
Hosted by Sara and Brady, this show is about infertility, loss, faith, marriage, and what it really takes — as a couple — to build the family you’ve been believing for.
From male factor infertility and IVF to pregnancy after loss, embryo adoption, and NICU life, we share honest conversations and real storytelling for couples trying to find hope through the hardest parts of the journey.
Sometimes messy, always real. Let’s do it together.

title: Heck, Why Not?
author: Mark Valladares
description: Real conversations. Real stories. Real life. Join Mark Valladares as he explores life’s biggest questions, everyday decisions, personal growth, relationships, money, business, and the lessons we all learn along the way. Every episode is designed to help you think differently, live wiser, and remind you that sometimes the best decision begins with one simple question… Heck, Why Not?

title: Christianity After Deconstruction: Cabernet and Pray
author: Jeremy Jernigan, Christian Deconstruction Pastor
description:
Cabernet and Pray is a podcast for people who still have questions about Jesus but have complicated feelings about the church and Christianity. Hosted by Jeremy Jernigan (a recovering megachurch pastor), each episode pairs a glass of wine with honest conversations about the Bible, deconstruction, reconstruction, and what it means to explore faith outside of the boundaries of the theological mainstream. If you've ever felt like your doubts disqualified you, or you've wondered whether there's a version of Christianity that can hold your questions without flinching, then you've found your people.

This podcast is for you if you find yourself asking questions such as:
*How do I make sense of my faith with all of my doubts?
*Can I still follow Jesus if I have issues with the church?
*Do I have to choose between my questions and my faith?
*What do I do with the parts of the Bible that trouble me?
*Where do I go when the Christianity I inherited stops working?
*Am I allowed to read the Bible outside of the interpretations I grew up with?

title: Aesops Fables - new translation
author: Aesop
description: Discover the timeless wisdom of Aesop with this fresh translation of 284 captivating fables. Each story offers valuable lessons on a variety of subjects, showcasing the cleverness and insight that has made Aesop a beloved author for generations.

title: Dalraida Baptist Church Podcast
author: dalraidabaptistchurch
description: Listen to Sunday morning's sermon from Dalraida Baptist Church each week!

title: AUDIO AA1-EV02
author: María Alejandra Lobo Valerio
description: Hello, my name is María Alejandra

title: Witchcraft, Planchette, and Spiritualism Unveiled
author: Harriet Beecher Stowe, Samuel Robert Wells
description: In this captivating exploration, we revisit a time not so distant when ignorance and superstition led to the persecution and execution of countless individuals. This thought-provoking review sheds light on the progress weve made in moral, intellectual, and physical sciences since those dark days. By examining the evolution of Phrenology and Psychology, we reflect on the grim realities of the past—where entire cities fell victim to religious bigotry. Today, we are fortunate to live in an age illuminated by scientific understanding, which fosters broader liberality, religious tolerance, and individual freedom. As we delve into Anatomy, Physiology, and the Natural Sciences, we empower ourselves to seek knowledge and accountability, not from dogma but from truth itself. Join us on this enlightening journey through history as we uncover the lessons learned from our ancestors trials. (Summary by Samuel Robert Wells)

title: The School of Self Reinvention
author: Sandy Wade
description: School of Self Reinvention is the go-to podcast for people who desire to change.  From author and Master Life Coach, Sandy Wade, comes the ultimate podcast for anyone looking for inspiration to totally reinvent themselves and change their life. Featuring candid interviews with people who have done just that.  Success leaves clues.  People learn so much from others who have been there and have come out the other side. We all have a story to tell.  Listen to extraordinary stories from ordinary people.  Come, be inspired, perhaps find the courage to do a self-reinvention of your own.  New episodes premiere every Saturday.Visit sandywade.net to start your own self reinvention!

title: The Jesus and ADHD Podcast
author: Rachel Grit
description:
This podcast is for women who want to seek, find, and live the abundant life Jesus offers by cutting down the noise and chaos in their lives and their brains. This is a place where everyone is welcome, everyone has a seat at the table, and everyone is seen and heard.
We'll talk about scripture, ADHD, listening prayer, forgiveness, and so much more. Join me on this journey to abundant life! 🪴

title: Proverb Reflections
author: Matt Johnson Music
description: Listen daily to the ancient wisdoms found within the Proverbs of Solomon. Each episode features a 15-minute melding of Matt Johnson’s thoughtful narration and sensitive piano improvisations. Cycle through the entire book of Proverbs every month using this “musical audiobook” devotional tool. Those wishing to listen to the music alone…while creating their own personal time of reflection/meditation…will find the companion “Just the Music™ series” features each track without narration. • www.MattJohnsonMusic.com •

title: Humans of Salesforce: Who We Are
author: Salesforce
description:
From day one, Salesforce has believed business is a platform for change. We are the builders, the changemakers, and the AI-native learners rewriting the status quo.
Joy is our North Star, and our values are our guide. Our 80,000+ 'Ohana members are our ultimate competitive advantage, and this show is about the ones you haven't met—yet.
These are the humans of Salesforce... and this is who we are.

title: Horizon Deep Tech '25: The podcast
author: Finaman.io
description:
Building the future—one conversation at a time.

The BuildingBusiness Podcast explores the ideas, technologies and people shaping tomorrow's world.

Hosted by entrepreneur Christian Arnø, each episode features honest conversations with founders, investors, researchers and industry leaders building the next generation of businesses across AI, deep tech, quantum computing, robotics, defense, health tech, climate technology and entrepreneurship.

Rather than focusing on headlines, we dive into the stories behind the companies—the challenges, breakthroughs, failures and lessons that rarely make it onto stage.

Whether recorded from international conferences, startup hubs or company headquarters, every episode is designed to give founders, innovators and curious minds practical insights into the technologies changing the way we live and work.

If you're passionate about innovation, startups and the future of business, you're in the right place.

Horizon Deep Tech 2025 Special Series

This special series was recorded live at Horizon Deep Tech 2025 in Madrid, featuring conversations with some of Europe's most exciting founders, researchers and technology leaders.

Across the series we explore:
Artificial Intelligence
Quantum Computing
HealthTech
Defense Technology
Robotics & Autonomous Systems
Digital Twins
Venture Capital
Deep Tech Entrepreneurship
Real conversations. Real innovators. Real technology shaping the future.

title: I Don't Wanna Be A POS
author: Carter Dockerty
description: Join comedian Carter Dockerty on a journey from being a typical 23 year old degenerate into becoming who knows what. Just hopefully not a 40 year old POS.

title: Automotive Intake
author: Automotive Intake
description: Two best friends talking about cars - something that has surely never happened before.

title: Lectio with Joshua
author: Joshua C. Strickler
description:
Lectio with Joshua is a quiet, contemplative space for Christian Scripture meditation and prayer, with new episodes released every other Tuesday. The first episode introduces the practice; every episode after that is a guided time of listening, silence, and reflection.
Support ongoing production at https://joshuastrickler.com/podcast/support-the-lectio-podcast/
Scripture quotations from the RSV © 1952, 1956, 1971 NCC. Used by permission. All rights reserved.
Lectio with Joshua © 2026 Joshua C. Strickler (admin by Strickler Editions). All rights reserved.

title: Boy Talk
author: Boys’ Education Commission
description: Boys are toxic. Lacking aspiration. Corrupted by the manosphere. Lost. Confused. Failing their exams. Lacking motivation. But how much of this is true? Are boys and young men a problem to be fixed, or the source of huge untapped potential. Boy Talk aims to find out. It’s a series of honest conversations about the challenges facing boys and young men hosted by Peter Hyman, Chair of the Boys’ Education Commission, and former headteacher and political advisor. He talks to fascinating people on the challenges boys face and how we can help them to thrive. With insights, personal stories, controversial views and calls for action, these lively 30 minute discussions have one big aim - to start a debate on how we get all boys to thrive. Whether you are a parent, a teacher, a young person, a charity, an employer or a policy maker - join the conversation.

title: Seed Thoughts
author: Joseph Caryl
description: Dive into the remarkable world of Seed Thoughts, where the extensive work of Joseph Caryl unfolds before you. This monumental text, spanning two mighty folios and thousands of densely printed pages, is a testament to the dedication of its author, who spent half a lifetime meticulously crafting his insights on the Book of Job. Caryl, known for his preaching at the Honourable Society of Lincolns Inn and later at St. Magnus near London Bridge, invites readers to explore a treasure trove of profound reflections. Though the full work may be too vast to reproduce, within it lies a wealth of thought-provoking ideas, comforting words for the afflicted, and clear statements of gospel doctrine that promise to enrich the minds and hearts of all who engage with them. Join us in uncovering these valuable insights that have stood the test of time.

title: Second Apology of Justin Martyr
author: Saint Justin Martyr
description: In this powerful defense of the Christian faith, St. Justin Martyr presents a compelling argument to the Roman Senate in the second century AD, eloquently articulating the beliefs and values of early Christians. (Summary by IWYLLPA)

title: Seaboard Parish
author: George MacDonald
description: In the second installment of the captivating trilogy, we return to the familiar faces of the first book, now enriched with new friends and family. The Pastor relocates to a picturesque seaside parish, where he begins a new chapter in his preaching journey. With two beloved daughters, one of whom is struggling with her health, the family seeks the healing embrace of the ocean air. During their stay, they encounter a charming artist whose gentlemanly demeanor and vibrant spirit capture their hearts, especially that of one daughter. Together, they embark on a series of heartwarming adventures filled with laughter, love, and the challenges of life in the Parish. Experience the enchanting world of The Seaboard Parish as it unfolds alongside Annals of a Quiet Neighbourhood and The Vicars Daughter.

title: Scripture Characters
author: Robert Smith Candlish
description: Dive into nineteen captivating studies of biblical figures—some renowned and others lesser-known. Originally crafted as sermons, these discourses have been thoughtfully transformed into compelling narratives. Join us on this enlightening journey through the lives and lessons of these scriptural characters. - Summary by InTheDesert

title: School of Obedience
author: Andrew Murray
description: In School of Obedience, Andrew Murray delves into the vital importance and transformative power of complete obedience to God. He articulates not only the necessity of this obedience for all believers but also the pathways to achieve it, emphasizing that such a level of commitment is possible through divine provision. (Summary by Joy Chan)

title: Scholia on the Incarnation of the Only-Begotten
author: Cyril of Alexandria
description: Dive into thirty-seven insightful articles that explore the profound question, What is Christ? Join us as we unpack the mystery of the Incarnation and its significance in our understanding of the divine.

title: Saved and Kept- or How to Get Saved and How to Keep Saved
author: G. A. McLaughlin
description: This concise volume is not meant to be a theological treatise or a comprehensive guide to the Christian life. Instead, the author aims to highlight the essential pathways through which sincere individuals can find salvation and maintain their faith. Written in straightforward, everyday language, this book is designed for those who seek clarity on the way to salvation. It is our hope that readers will find guidance and encouragement in their journey, ultimately leading them to a fulfilling relationship with God. With this purpose in mind, we present this work, praying it serves as a beacon for anyone eager to discover what God has in store for them.

title: Satan
author: Lewis Sperry Chafer
description: Discover the profound insights of a compelling Christian book that delves into the life and tactics of Satan. title: Wicca Calling
author: Wicca Calling
description: A look at the birthplace of modern Wicca, exploring its New Forest origins, historical figures like Gerald Gardner, and how the craft is practiced today.

title: EnlightenUp
author: ian
description: mini morsels of mindfulness, magic, meaning and mojo

title: Abba Coffee care
author: ABBACoffee Cafe
description: At ABBA Coffee Cafe, every cup has its own story. We serve freshly brewed coffee, handcrafted drinks, and delicious bites in a warm, welcoming space. Whether you're catching up with friends or enjoying a quiet break, we're here to make every visit feel special - one cup at a time.

title: Albion's Occult
author: Albion's Occult
description: Diving into the hidden history of British esotericism, from the Elizabethan magic of John Dee to the Victorian era's Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn.

title: RISE (Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport & Exercise)
author: Rebecca McConville & Kassidy Johnson
description: RISE pulls back the curtain on REDs—the silent performance killer. Hosted by a world-leading expert, this podcast delivers straight-talking insights, athlete stories, and science-backed strategies to help you fuel smarter, train stronger, and perform at your peak.

title: A BETTER WAY PODCAST
author: Dr. John Idahosa
description: Welcome to my world of limitless possibilities.

title: The Celtic Knot
author: The Celtic Knot
description: Unraveling the intertwined threads of Celtic Christianity, ancient paganism, and nature-based spirituality that continue to thrive in Wales, Scotland, and Ireland.

title: The Redacted Files
author: Hand
description:
Every file tells a story. Some should never have been opened.
Welcome to The Redacted Files—your destination for SCP case files, anomalous entities, unexplained mysteries, forgotten experiments, and chilling stories hidden deep within classified archives.
If you enjoy psychological horror, eerie mysteries, and immersive storytelling, you’ve just found your next obsession. New files released weekly.

title: Beyond the Clinic
author: MPF Federal
description:
Welcome to our Expert Panel Series, where MPF's internal experts and invited guests unpack the questions shaping the future of health care, AI, and workforce optimization. Each episode brings practitioners together for candid, substantive conversation on how emerging technology is transforming the future across federal and commercial environments.


Subscribe for expert perspectives at the intersection of artificial intelligence, health care innovation, and organizational excellence.

Find out more at www.mpfllc.com

title: Center for Women Entrepreneurs Podcast
author: Center for Women Entrepreneurs
description: The CWE Podcast is where entrepreneurs come to learn, connect, and grow. Through inspiring conversations and practical insights from business leaders, industry experts, and fellow entrepreneurs, we provide the tools and inspiration to help you scale and expand your business.

title: Stones & Henges
author: Stones & Henges
description: A historical and spiritual journey across the British Isles, examining the significance, rituals, and modern veneration of ancient megaliths and stone circles.

title: The Unfathomable Isles
author: The Unfathomable Isles
description: An exploration of the deep, unfathomable mysteries of British folklore, earth energies, and the ancient ley lines that crisscross the countryside.

title: The Avalon Echoes
author: Jola
description: Delving into the enduring magic of Glastonbury and the Arthurian legends, this podcast explores how ancient myths shape modern spiritual practices across the UK.

title: The Garden Grimoire
author: Brooke Pennington
description:
Welcome to a cozy corner for lovers of the strange, the magical, and the mysterious. Wander with us through stories of ghosts, folklore, cryptids, haunted history, paranormal encounters, and the unexplained.  If you find comfort in candlelight and things that go bump in the night, you've found your place. 


Follow us on Instagram @The_Garden_Grimoire!

title: Off Book & Off Duty
author: Mr Boydon & Miss Simons
description:
The performing arts teaching podcast that is anything but scripted.

Each episode, extraordinary, passionate and quirky drama teachers Mr Boydon and Miss Simons sit down to discuss the ins, outs, stage rights and stage lefts of teaching drama in the UK school system.


Themes include Back to School, how teachers really feel about the summer holidays, and whether school trips are actually just an excuse for international travel.


Off Book and Off Duty is trying very hard to win a British Podcast Award and can't wait for the awards ceremony... if they ever get invited.


Everyone is welcome here – teachers, children and non-teachers alike.


Pick an episode and enjoy!


This podcast has been independently produced with hope, enthusiasm and overreaching ambition at its heart.

title: wax. connects with...
author: wax. connects
description:
At wax. connect, we believe the life sciences industry is built on meaningful connections - between people, ideas, innovation and opportunity.

wax. connects with... is a conversation series celebrating the people behind the industry - building connections, sharing experiences and creating conversations that others can learn from. 

Our aim is to create conversations that help others navigate their own careers, whether they're just starting out, exploring a new direction, progressing into leadership or simply looking to learn from the experience of others across the life sciences community. 

Regular short and impactful episodes ideal for adding to your daily commute or listening to on your coffee break.

Interested in taking part or starting the connection? Email tellmemore@waxconnect.com

title: Host With Confidence with Becky Guzak
author: Becky Guzak
description: Host with Confidence is dedicated to empowering the hesitant host to entertain with confidence and ease. Becky Guzak is passionate about helping people build their confidence and communities through entertaining. Join her as she shares stories, strategies, and inspiration to help eliminate the stress and amplify the joy of bringing people together.

title: What A Ride with Pat McCool
author: Pat McCool
description: After a childhood of juvenile delinquency, 20 years as a business executive, and 25 years on the comedy road surviving bad gigs, wild risks and near-disasters, I've learned one thing: life is a heck of a journey. Join me, Pat McCool, for a weekly look at the crazy stories, funny incidents, and thoughtful reflections from a lifetime lived without a safety net. Grab a seat, buckle up, and welcome to the ride.

title: Beyond Sunday
author: Porter Memorial Baptist Church
description: Beyond Sunday's is a weekly podcast from Porter Memorial Baptist Church that continues the conversation beyond Sunday morning through biblical discussion, pastoral insight, and practical application. Join members of our pastoral team as we dive deeper into Scripture, answer listener questions, discuss SBC and current events through a biblical lens, and encourage one another to follow Christ throughout the week.

title: Orbit: Science for kids on the move!
author: Cumbre Kids
description:
Publishing "Wild Critters," a series with PBS Nature and the National Wildlife Federation! 🦬 

Science made simple to help kids better understand the world around them. 

For kids ages 3-11. Perfect for car rides, family adventures, and learning on the go!  


'Orbit' sparks curiosity, builds STEM vocabulary, and inspires kids to think like scientists as they explore the amazing world we live in! 🚀 


🌟 Send us your questions: https://www.cumbrekids.org/questions 

🌟 Our promise to parents: www.cumbrekids.org/our-values

title: Moms Who Need Vacations
author: Samantha Jones
description:
Welcome to Moms Who Need Vacations, the podcast for busy moms who deserve something to look forward to.

I’m Samantha, your travel advisor and fellow mom, here to help you plan unforgettable vacations without the overwhelm. Each week, we’ll talk about Disney destinations, cruises, all-inclusive resorts, family travel, destination weddings, girls’ getaways, budgeting, travel tips, and the real-life moments that remind us why making memories matters.

Whether you’re dreaming of your next adventure, planning your first Disney vacation, or simply looking for a little escape from everyday life, you’re in the right place.

Because vacations aren’t just about where you go, they’re about reconnecting with the people you love and giving yourself permission to rest, explore, and make memories that last a lifetime.

So grab your coffee, take a deep breath, and let’s start planning your next escape.

title: Wamorenajeso
author: Tumi Wmj
description: Wamorenajeso Podcast is a space where faith meets real life through honest conversations, bold perspectives and practical wisdom for navigating purpose, identity and growth. Rooted in truth and inspired by everyday experiences, each episode explores what it means to live intentionally, impact communities and walk confidently in who you are becoming. Whether you are seeking clarity, encouragement or deeper understanding, this podcast walks with you as you grow in faith, discover your voice and step fully into a purpose filled life with courage and conviction.

title: Red Hot and Unfiltered
author: Ally and Nico

title: On The Brightside
author: Erin
description: Destiny is calling and true Buffalo Bills fans are always ready to pick up. Join us for an insightful and amusing look at the 2026-2027 season.

title: The Counder Podcast
author: Counder • The Network for Collective Understanding
description: Collective Understanding, One Perspective at a Time. Everybody wants to understand what is going on in the world. We sit down with leading voices from across geographies, industries, and generations to unpack their perspectives — and bring their insights to everyone.

title: Reembok Arcane
author: Reema
description:
Reembok Arcane is a cinematic storytelling podcast exploring the strange, emotional, and unforgettable stories behind mystery, history, and human destiny.
Hosted by Reema, each episode goes beyond headlines and statistics to uncover the deeper story — the pressure behind motives, and the hidden patterns that make life feel almost scripted.

title: 2 Real Witches
author: Oak & Dani
description: Two witches sharing ideas, insights, and interviews.

title: The Bevlab Podcast
author: Bevlab
description:
Welcome to the Bevlab Podcast -- the show where we crack open an ice cold Enny & talk training, formulas, business, and whatever else comes up when two friends with too much caffeine sit down with mics.
Hosted by Cody and Ben, Bevlab is your backstage pass to the energy drink and supplement world… plus unfiltered conversations about building brands, leveling up as athletes, and navigating real life in the fitness industry.

title: From Boys to Men: A Journey Through Masculinity
author: Nav
description: Honest conversations about masculinity, intimacy, shame, desire, and healing. From Boys to Men is a podcast about what happens when we stop performing masculinity and start becoming more fully ourselves.

title: The Lying Liars Who Lied When They Said They Loved You
author: Barry Floore
description:
Toxic relationships. Codependency. Domestic violence. Substance abuse. Mental illness. Sex. Men. Psychosis.

These are the lies I told myself, and the lies told by the lying liars who told me they loved me when they knocked on my door.

Tune in.

More lies ahead.

A fictionalized semi autobiographical novel and podcast about the last few years of my life.
